Remark
[geodesic loops are closed geodesics]

Source: petersen:page-0405 ↗ def:pet-ch10-tp-decomposition 1. ch10:10.5.1Let $M$ be a symmetric space and $X\in t_p$ nontrivial (so $X$ is a Killing field with $(\nabla X)|_p=0$). Show: (1) the flow of $X$ is $F_s=A_{\exp (sX|_p)}\circ A_p$; (2) $c(t)=\exp (tX|_p)$ is an axis for $F_s$, i.e. $F_s(c(t))=c(t+s)$; (3) if $c(a)=c(b)$ then $\dot c(a)=\dot c(b)$; (4) conclude that geodesic loops are always closed geodesics.
